nodes.label: Chrono_peridynamics library target
nodes.rationale: Force-disables itself when CH_ENABLE_MODULE_FEA is off. Note a latent defect: the header install rule references ${Chrono_PardisoMKL_HEADERS} (an undefined variable in this scope, copy-pasted from the PardisoMKL module) instead of ${Chrono_PERIDYNAMICS_HEADERS}, so no headers are installed by that rule. It also lacks the Chrono::peridynamics ALIAS and DEBUG_POSTFIX that every sibling module sets.
